name: Industrial Relations and Other Legislation Amendment (Miscellaneous)  Bill 2026
question: That is not surprising because, unlike our Labor colleagues, we are bound by our policies and our principles. We do not get to have our own special little parliamentary party that has different ideas about the world. We actually have to listen to our members. We have a level of accountability and integrity such that we have to vote in accordance with the things we said we would do, not just during the election, but at all times. People can read our election and policy platforms on our website. People want a political party that says, "We are standing up for workers" and then, when it comes to the vote, actually does it. Yet again The Greens are moving a bunch of very sensible amendments, all of them in the Labor Party platform. But yet again Labor members are voting against them. For the Government to say that workers are feeling better now than they did five years ago is completely out of touch. It is exactly why people are turning away from both major parties in droves.
